# SINNVO (星沃)

> Premium villa elevators. SINNVO designs, manufactures and installs custom home and villa elevators in Huzhou, Zhejiang, China, for homes worldwide. Sales, R&D, manufacturing and installation are under one roof.

- Fully custom (non-standard) cabins, made to order; designs draw on Eastern and Western heritage.
- Four shaft and drive structures: Traction Gantry, Small Gantry, Backpack Frame, Strong-Drive.
- No pit required, low headroom, right-angle and three-way door layouts.
- Eight built-in safety systems, including power-failure self-leveling, an intelligent light curtain, a child-safety lock and cloud monitoring.
- Every panel is hand-finished and checked before it ships.

## Requesting a quote
Send shaft width × depth (finished internal, mm), pit depth and overhead height (or say a pit is not possible), number of floors and travel height, and the cabin look you want through the [contact page](https://sinnvoelevator.com/contact.html). SINNVO usually replies within two business days.
